en-US.longDescription: MrBayes is a program for Bayesian inference and model choice across a wide range of phylogenetic and evolutionary models. MrBayes uses Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods to estimate the posterior distribution of model parameters.
en-US.name: MrBayes

zh-CN.description: 系统发育的贝叶斯推断
zh-CN.longDescription: MrBayes 是一个用于在大量系统发育和进化的模型中进行贝叶斯推断和模型选择的程序。MrBayes 使用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法来估计模型参数的后验分布。
zh-CN.name: MrBayes
